beats.vo: Hello, champ! Welcome back to Mentr Learn. I am so happy you came back for class.
beats.caption: Hello, champ! Welcome back

beats.vo: Quick memory check. In Chapter one, we learned the three jobs: input, process, output. In Chapter two, we learned binary — ones and zeros.
beats.caption: Ch 1: Input · Process · Output  ·  Ch 2: Binary

beats.vo: Today is Chapter three. The lesson is: Input and Output Devices.
beats.caption: Chapter 3 · Input & Output Devices

beats.vo: Say it with me… Input… and… Output… Devices.
beats.caption: Say with me: Input & Output Devices

beats.vo: Wonderful! Today we will meet real machines you can touch and use.
beats.caption: Let's meet real devices!

beats.vo: Imagine a computer that is just a closed box. No keyboard, no mouse, no screen, no speaker.
beats.caption: A closed box… no keyboard, no screen

beats.vo: Two questions. How would you tell it what to do? And how would it show you the answer?
beats.caption: How do we tell it? How does it answer?

beats.vo: Pause and think for three seconds…
beats.caption: Your turn — think!

beats.vo: Here is the answer. A computer needs doors — a door for things to come in, and a door for things to go out.
beats.caption: It needs an IN door and an OUT door

beats.vo: These doors are special machines called devices.
beats.caption: Doors = devices

beats.vo: Input devices bring information IN to the computer.
beats.caption: INPUT devices → bring information IN

beats.vo: Output devices send information OUT from the computer, to you.
beats.caption: OUTPUT devices → send information OUT

beats.vo: Remember input, process, output from Chapter one? Input devices do the first job. Output devices do the last job.
beats.caption: Input devices · Process · Output devices

beats.vo: Say with me: In… comes in. Out… goes out!
beats.caption: Say: IN comes in · OUT goes out!

beats.vo: Let's meet the input devices. These are the ones that take things from you.
beats.caption: Meet the INPUT devices

beats.vo: Number one: the keyboard. When you type letters and numbers, they go into the computer. Input!
beats.caption: Keyboard → you type → INPUT

beats.vo: Number two: the mouse. You move it, point, and click. Your click goes in. Input!
beats.caption: Mouse → point & click → INPUT

beats.vo: Number three: the microphone. It listens to your voice and sends it in. Input!
beats.caption: Microphone → listens → INPUT

beats.vo: Number four: the camera. It takes your picture or video and sends it in. Input!
beats.caption: Camera → takes pictures → INPUT

beats.vo: Keyboard, mouse, microphone, camera — all four bring information in.
beats.caption: 4 input devices: all bring information IN

beats.vo: Now, the output devices. These give things back to you.
beats.caption: Meet the OUTPUT devices

beats.vo: The screen shows you words, pictures, and videos. Output!
beats.caption: Screen → shows pictures → OUTPUT

beats.vo: The speaker plays sounds and music for your ears. Output!
beats.caption: Speaker → plays sound → OUTPUT

beats.vo: The printer puts your work on paper, so you can hold it. Output!
beats.caption: Printer → prints on paper → OUTPUT

beats.vo: Screen, speaker, printer — they all send information out to you.
beats.caption: 3 output devices: all send information OUT

beats.vo: Now a tricky one. A microphone and a speaker both deal with sound. So which is which?
beats.caption: Tricky: mic and speaker both use sound!

beats.vo: The microphone listens. It takes your sound in. So it is input.
beats.caption: Microphone listens → takes IN → INPUT

beats.vo: The speaker talks. It gives sound out to you. So it is output.
beats.caption: Speaker talks → gives OUT → OUTPUT

beats.vo: Here is a super trick. Ask: does it take from me, or give to me? Takes from me — input. Gives to me — output.
beats.caption: TAKES from me → INPUT · GIVES to me → OUTPUT

beats.vo: Say the trick with me: Takes — input. Gives — output!
beats.caption: Say: Takes = input · Gives = output!

beats.vo: Some devices are extra clever. Look at a touchscreen, like on a tablet or phone.
beats.caption: Some devices are extra clever…

beats.vo: When you tap it with your finger, your touch goes in. That is input.
beats.caption: You tap → your touch goes IN

beats.vo: And the same screen shows you pictures and games. That is output.
beats.caption: Screen shows pictures → OUT

beats.vo: So a touchscreen does both jobs — input and output!
beats.caption: Touchscreen = BOTH input and output

beats.vo: A headset with a mic is also both. The mic takes your voice in, and the earphones give sound out.
beats.caption: Headset: mic IN + earphones OUT

beats.vo: Game time! I show a device. You shout: input, output, or both!
beats.caption: Sorting game — shout your answer!

beats.vo: Keyboard… input or output?
beats.caption: Keyboard — input or output?

beats.vo: Input! You type, it goes in.
beats.caption: Keyboard → INPUT

beats.vo: Screen… input or output?
beats.caption: Screen — input or output?

beats.vo: Output! It shows pictures to you.
beats.caption: Screen → OUTPUT

beats.vo: Microphone… input or output?
beats.caption: Microphone — input or output?

beats.vo: Input! It listens to your voice.
beats.caption: Microphone → INPUT

beats.vo: Printer… input or output?
beats.caption: Printer — input or output?

beats.vo: Output! It gives you paper.
beats.caption: Printer → OUTPUT

beats.vo: Camera… input or output?
beats.caption: Camera — input or output?

beats.vo: Input! It takes your picture in.
beats.caption: Camera → INPUT

beats.vo: Speaker… input or output?
beats.caption: Speaker — input or output?

beats.vo: Output! It gives sound to your ears.
beats.caption: Speaker → OUTPUT

beats.vo: Last one. Touchscreen… careful!
beats.caption: Touchscreen — careful!

beats.vo: Both! Your tap goes in, and pictures come out.
beats.caption: Touchscreen → BOTH

beats.vo: Seven out of seven? Give yourself a big clap, champ!
beats.caption: Big clap for you, champ!

beats.vo: Now a real-life story. You are on a video call with your Nani.
beats.caption: Story: a video call with Nani

beats.vo: Your laptop camera sees your smile, and the microphone hears your hello. Those are input devices.
beats.caption: Camera + microphone → your face & voice go IN

beats.vo: The computers do the process job and send it across the internet.
beats.caption: Computers process and send it across

beats.vo: On Nani's side, the screen shows your face and the speaker plays your voice. Output devices!
beats.caption: Nani's screen + speaker → OUTPUT

beats.vo: And when Nani says, hello beta, the same thing happens back to you. Input, process, output!
beats.caption: Same trip back: input → process → output

beats.vo: Your turn to be a detective. Look around your home or classroom.
beats.caption: Device detective — look around you!

beats.vo: Find one input device and one output device. Point to them. I will wait.
beats.caption: Find 1 INPUT + 1 OUTPUT

beats.vo: Here is an example. A TV remote — you press buttons, so it is input. The TV screen shows the cartoon, so it is output.
beats.caption: Remote → INPUT · TV screen → OUTPUT

beats.vo: Great detective work, champ!
beats.caption: Great detective work!

beats.vo: Practice check — the same kind of question you will see later.
beats.caption: Practice check

beats.vo: Is a speaker an input device or an output device?
beats.caption: Speaker: INPUT or OUTPUT?

beats.vo: Use the trick. Does it take from you, or give to you?
beats.caption: Trick: takes from you, or gives to you?

beats.vo: Yes! A speaker is output, because it gives sound out to you.
beats.caption: Answer: OUTPUT — it gives sound to you

beats.vo: Let's lock it in. Input devices bring information in: keyboard, mouse, microphone, camera.
beats.caption: INPUT: keyboard · mouse · mic · camera

beats.vo: Output devices send information out: screen, speaker, printer.
beats.caption: OUTPUT: screen · speaker · printer

beats.vo: Some devices, like a touchscreen, do both.
beats.caption: BOTH: touchscreen

beats.vo: And the trick: takes from you — input. Gives to you — output.
beats.caption: Takes → input · Gives → output

beats.vo: Chapter three done. Input and Output Devices — fantastic work today!
beats.caption: Chapter 3 complete!

beats.vo: Next, a short quiz to practise. Tap Finish when you are ready. See you there, champ!
beats.caption: Next: Quiz · Tap Finish
